title: Plant / OT Incident Command
tagline: Turn a safety or operational incident into a documented, escalated decision in minutes, not shifts.
painPoint: Plant incidents live in radio calls and paper logs until someone finally writes it up — hours after the fact.

steps.caption: Incident command, live
steps.talk: This is plant safety incident response the way it should work: the moment a threat is confirmed, the clock is already running against you.

steps.caption: Loading a real incident
steps.talk: We're loading a realistic incident — the kind that normally triggers an all-hands war room call and a scramble for a status update.

steps.caption: Six engines, one click
steps.talk: Six specialist engines — safety, containment, root cause, compliance, production impact, remediation — analyze this simultaneously. What normally takes a team an hour of frantic message threads happens here in seconds.

steps.caption: Escalate with full context
steps.talk: Escalating to the strategist — it doesn't start from zero, it inherits everything the engines already found.

steps.caption: Executive approval, one click
steps.talk: One click and this is now on the executive's desk with an approve action ready — no waiting for the shift report to get written up.

steps.caption: The close
steps.talk: This is the pitch: response measured in seconds, not hours — and a fully documented decision trail for the board and regulators afterward.

cta: TSM gives plant leadership a defensible, timestamped decision trail while the incident is still unfolding.
